attributes.board_name: Delaware Board of Examiners of Speech/Language Pathologists, Audiologists & Hearing Aid Dispensers (Division of Professional Regulation)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE (advance approval may be requested). 1 CE = 60 minutes; CEUs from other organizations are converted (1.0 ASHA CEU = 10 CEs). Minimum 20 CEs in clinical skills (prevention, assessment, diagnosis, treatment); maximum 10 CEs in professional growth. Job duties such as staff meetings and CPR are excluded.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE if the license was issued for less than 1 year of the period; 15 CEs if issued on or after Aug 1 of an odd year (covers more than 1 but less than 2 years). Temporary (CFY) licensees are exempt.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; selected licensees must document completion. CE is entered in the DELPROS CE tracker.
rules.notes: Licensure period Aug 1 – Jul 31, renewal by July 31 of odd-numbered years. Dual licensees: 30 CEs total with 15 in each specialty. A 2025 proposal (28 DE Reg 720) would add 2 ethics hours within the 30 for the period Aug 1, 2025 – Jul 31, 2027; adoption of a final rule could not be confirmed online, so check the board before renewal.
